objective: Certificar en solo lectura el fix integrado R7C-R3 de /api/unidades-negocio. Validar código, pruebas y datos canónicos de David UsuarioID 9. Confirmar que sus unidades efectivas se derivan con la misma política RBAC de RBACSQLService.get_unidades y que cada unidad puede proyectar una sucursal visible para frontend mediante sucursal_origen_id o codigo, sin usar allowed_servers legacy, sin ampliar scope y sin tocar Produccion.

queries.name: david_effective_units_with_frontend_branch_projection
queries.sql: WITH ActiveUnits AS (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100),u.id) AS UnidadNegocioID,TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100),u.server_id) AS ServidorID,NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100),u.sucursal_origen_id))),'') AS SucursalOrigenID,COUNT_BIG(*) OVER (PARTITION BY u.server_id) AS ActiveUnitsOnServer FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio u WHERE ISNULL(u.activo,0)=1),ExplicitScope AS (SELECT usa.UsuarioID,TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100),usa.ServidorID) AS ServidorID,CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS SucursalCodigo,CAST('SERVER' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ScopeType FROM dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion usa WHERE usa.UsuarioID=9 AND ISNULL(usa.Activo,1)=1 UNION ALL SELECT usa.UsuarioID,TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100),usa.ServidorID) AS ServidorID,NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100),usa.SucursalCodigo))),'') AS SucursalCodigo,CAST('BRANCH' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS ScopeType FROM dbo.Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion usa WHERE usa.UsuarioID=9 AND ISNULL(usa.Activo,1)=1),EffectiveUnits AS (SELECT DISTINCT au.UnidadNegocioID FROM ActiveUnits au INNER JOIN ExplicitScope es ON LOWER(au.ServidorID)=LOWER(es.ServidorID) AND ((au.ActiveUnitsOnServer=1 AND es.ScopeType='SERVER') OR (au.ActiveUnitsOnServer=1 AND es.ScopeType='BRANCH') OR (au.ActiveUnitsOnServer>1 AND es.ScopeType='BRANCH' AND au.SucursalOrigenID IS NOT NULL AND es.SucursalCodigo IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(au.SucursalOrigenID)))=UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(es.SucursalCodigo))))) WHERE au.UnidadNegocioID IS NOT NULL) SELECT CAST(u.id AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS UnidadNegocioID,u.codigo AS UnidadCodigo,u.nombre AS UnidadNombre,CAST(u.server_id AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS ServidorID,u.sucursal_origen_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100),u.sucursal_origen_id))),''),u.codigo) AS FrontendSucursalID,sc.nombre AS ServidorNombre FROM EffectiveUnits eu INNER JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio u ON LOWER(CAST(u.id AS NVARCHAR(100)))=LOWER(eu.UnidadNegocioID) LEFT JOIN dbo.Servidores_Conexiones sc ON TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,u.server_id)=sc.id ORDER BY u.codigo

queries.name: david_explicit_branch_assignments
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(ServidorID AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS ServidorID,SucursalCodigo,Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion WHERE UsuarioID=9 AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 ORDER BY ServidorID,SucursalCodigo

queries.name: david_identity_postcheck
queries.sql: SELECT UsuarioID,Email,NombreCompleto,Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo WHERE UsuarioID=9
